Priya M.: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands - teams asked for a short checklist for release cadence, oncall changes, and rollout quality gates. Can we capture owners?
Sam H.: Short decisions: prefer 3-week planning as the default; not mandatory. Primary oncall -> 7-day shifts (Mon-Sun) to reduce handovers. No change to secondary night coverage.
Zara T.: Will we have a temporary release-freeze option for big infra migrations?
Sam H.: Yes \u2014 we will declare scheduled blackout windows (opt-in per-team) for infra migrations. Require +1 week notice and a maintenance tag on deploys.
Devon R.: Paging / incident timings?
Sam H.: Sev1: page immediately, ack <= 15m, mitigation plan <= 30m. Add a 2-hour post-deploy smoke check and 24-hour health check for major rollouts.
Ken P.: SLA commitments for Dedicated customers?
Sam H.: Publish per-profile SLAs. Default Dedicated gen profile: p95 <= 250ms, p99 guardrail 1s. Long-context profiles will have explicit numbers in the model catalog.
Zara T.: What about quality gates for model rollouts?
Sam H.: Requirement: prerelease eval harness + canary. Gate = no >2% regression in embedding similarity and no safety violations. Canary template example inline: `canary: [5,25,100]; metrics: [p95_latency,error_rate,quality_regressions]`
Devon R.: Auto-promote behavior?
Sam H.: CI auto-promote after 2 consecutive green checks and 30m with no new errors. Ops can abort or force-rollback. Auto-rollback thresholds: error_rate delta >0.5% or quality_regressions >1% in canary.
Priya M.: Owners: Sam land canary template in infra repo; Zara coordinate blackout windows; Devon update runbooks and smoke tests; Ken draft SLA comms. Drop PR links in #eng-process. :thumbsup:
